title: Bacons hub premium
script:
-- Bacons Premium Hub - Lennon Hub adaptado para Steal a Brainrot
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- GUI principal
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "BaconsPremiumHub"
screenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 500)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -250)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

-- Título
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,50)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
title.Text = "Bacons Premium Hub"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
title.TextScaled = true
title.Parent = mainFrame

-- Frame de comandos
local commandFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
commandFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
commandFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,50)
commandFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
commandFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
commandFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,2,0)
commandFrame.Parent = mainFrame

-- Função para criar botões
local function createButton(name, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 50)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,(#commandFrame:GetChildren()-1)*55)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.Text = name
    button.Parent = commandFrame
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return button
end

-- =========================
-- COMANDOS DO LENNON HUB
-- =========================

-- Fly
createButton("Fly", function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,50,0)
            bv.Parent = hrp
            wait(5)
            bv:Destroy()
        end
    end
end)

-- Speed
createButton("Speed", function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100 -- ajuste conforme quiser
    end
end)

-- JumpPower
createButton("JumpPower", function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.JumpPower = 150
    end
end)

-- Teleport para outro jogador
createButton("Teleport To Player", function()
    local target = Players:GetPlayers()[2] -- exemplo: teleport para o segundo jogador
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and target.Character then
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
    end
end)

-- Freeze jogador
createButton("Freeze Player", function()
    for i,v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= LocalPlayer and v.Character then
            v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
        end
    end
end)

-- Unfreeze jogador
createButton("Unfreeze Player", function()
    for i,v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v.Character then
            v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
        end
    end
end)

-- Kill
createButton("Kill Player", function()
    for i,v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= LocalPlayer and v.Character then
            v.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
        end
    end
end)

-- Kick
createButton("Kick Player", function()
    for i,v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= LocalPlayer then
            v:Kick("Você foi expulso pelo Bacons Premium Hub")
        end
    end
end)

-- Invisibility
createButton("Invisibility", function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        for i,v in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ESP (destacar jogadores)
createButton("ESP", function()
    for i,v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= LocalPlayer and v.Character then
            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.Adornee = v.Character
            highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
            highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            highlight.Parent = v.Character
        end
    end
end)

-- Gravity
createButton("Gravity", function()
    workspace.Gravity = 20 -- ajuste conforme quiser
end)
